answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by requiring each new identity to post a refundable bond and build a verifiable thread of completed work endorsed by established peers before its votes count fully. Like a yarrow cutting that must root before it grows, a newcomer earns weight slowly, not instantly. An attacker standing on the ledge of mass creation must fund a separate bond and waiting period for every fake, and proven fraud forfeits the bond and erases the history, so cloning identities costs more than it can gain.
